source: Aceternity UI — https://ui.aceternity.com/ (200+ React + Tailwind + Motion, shadcn compatible)

install.init: npx aceternity-ui init  # ou: npx shadcn@latest init
install.add_one: npx aceternity-ui add bento-grid  # ou: npx shadcn@latest add aceternity/bento-grid

mcp.description: MCP Server for AI agents (browse/search/install via natural language)
mcp.for_agent: Add 'aceternity' registry to components.json:13 then: npx shadcn@latest add aceternity/{component}

for_factory.frontend_agent: Use 'frontend-design' (838K) + 'vercel-react-best-practices' (678K) + 'web-design-guidelines' (594K) after aceternity install to verify perf/a11y

policy: Free components OK — All-Access Pass premium blocks require license check before commit
